the simple idea

How Art 4 Charity works

Three steps, no fine print. Pick a piece, and half the money goes straight to a good cause.

1

Pick a piece (or commission one)

Browse the gallery for an original painting or drawing, or ask Lorelai to make something just for you.

2

Choose where the good goes

Every piece is tagged with a cause — animal shelters, kids' hospitals, food banks, ocean cleanup. Your purchase supports the one on its tag.

3

Half is donated, always

50% of the price goes to the cause. The rest covers art supplies and Lorelai's time — and every donation gets posted so you can see it happened.

Where the money goes

Drag the slider to a price and see exactly how a sale splits up. Every piece in the gallery follows the same 50 / 20 / 30 rule.

$40

A $40 piece sends $20.00 to a local animal shelter.

  • Donated to the cause — 50% $20.00
  • Paint, paper & shipping — 20% $8.00
  • To the artist — 30% $12.00

Every donation is posted here once it's made, so you can see exactly where the money went.

meet the artist

About Lorelai

LJ

Lorelai is a teenage artist who works in watercolor, gouache, acrylic, and whatever markers are closest to hand. She started Art 4 Charity because selling art felt good — but selling art that also feeds shelter cats, stocks food bank shelves, and cleans up beaches felt even better.

When she isn't painting, she's probably sketching anyway. Every piece here is drawn and painted by her, signed on the back, and shipped with a note about where its donation went.

the people behind the paint

My Inspiration

Behind every piece of art are the people who cheer Lorelai on. Here they are, in her own words.

D

Dad

My father has always helped me find my inspiration either by drives or occasional hikes and he has an absolute love for Pokémon and Gears of War, he loves his family and video games, and he has a “funny” sense of humor. Lol, I really don’t understand it at times.

E

Emersyn

My little sister shares my love and appreciation for art and has my love for Minecraft, she is one of my reasons for making art, and she is super funny, kind and smart. She is also sometimes my little critic.

M

Mom

My mom is my superhero she has been by my side since day one and she has always believed in me and she has a very overactive ABA brain, not a lot of people understand it but that’s why I’m her daughter and her mini translator.

A

Amber

Amber is my stepmom and probably the funniest woman I know, my favorite thing about her is her love for fashion, and her nickname given to her from my dad, Pizza.

D

Derek

Derek is my step dad and my favorite boyfriend out of all the ones my mom has had, (besides dad of Corse) I’m very thankful for him because he’s never given up on me even when he could have.
